readings.title: Artemis Fowl
readings.finding: KBp303021128/p336120257 explicitly Dutch translated first novel, Mireille Vroege, Van Goor, 263p. Exact 2007ISBN9789047500445 is a softcover; OL27098593M parentOL5725956W matches existing Work264. 2020filmcover is the same original novel, not evidence to substitute its printing. English Lijsters9789001839246 is not approved as Dutch. Books API response for2001ISBN combined three novels and was rejected as exact edition evidence.

readings.title: Crescent Dawn
readings.finding: Primary publisher explicitly credits Dirk jointly with Clive Cussler for Crescent Dawn; not a narrator. Official chronology dates original16November2010. Dutch edition identity and cover require their own check.

readings.title: Garden of Shadows
readings.finding: Primary publisher credits V.C.Andrews; copyright1987VandaProductions, current ebook2011 is not original publication. Dollanganger prequel: Olivia Winfield marries Malcolm Foxworth and moves to Foxworth Hall. No new combined ghostwriter identity; do not copy publisher excerpt.

readings.title: One Day at a Time / Prodigal Son
readings.finding: Danielle Steel is the author, Luis Murillo is a Spanish translator and Mel Foster a narrator. Original novel dates February2009 and February2015. Later paperbacks2010/2016 must not replace original years. Exact Dutch print, summary and cover remain separately bound.

readings.title: Welkom in het rijk der zieken
readings.finding: Primary publisher confirms Hanna Bervoets and substantive Clay/Q-fever/long-term-illness premise. Current9789083095370 is2021/280p, not proposed2019ISBN9789492928283/320p; do not overwrite that printing with current page values.
